scripts.zk:ptau: snarkjs powersoftau new bn128 12 ptau/pot12_0000.ptau -v && snarkjs powersoftau contribute ptau/pot12_0000.ptau ptau/pot12_0001.ptau --name="FundProof local ptau" -v -e="fundproof local entropy" && snarkjs powersoftau prepare phase2 ptau/pot12_0001.ptau ptau/pot12_final.ptau -v
scripts.zk:setup: snarkjs groth16 setup build/circuits/fundproof.r1cs ptau/pot12_final.ptau build/circuits/fundproof_0000.zkey
scripts.zk:contribute: snarkjs zkey contribute build/circuits/fundproof_0000.zkey build/circuits/fundproof_final.zkey --name="FundProof local contribution" -v -e="fundproof zkey entropy"
scripts.zk:export-vkey: snarkjs zkey export verificationkey build/circuits/fundproof_final.zkey build/circuits/verification_key.json
scripts.zk:prove: snarkjs groth16 fullprove build/circuits/input.json build/circuits/fundproof_js/fundproof.wasm build/circuits/fundproof_final.zkey build/circuits/proof.json build/circuits/public.json
scripts.zk:verify: snarkjs groth16 verify build/circuits/verification_key.json build/circuits/public.json build/circuits/proof.json
scripts.zk:all: npm run zk:compile && npm run zk:ptau && npm run zk:setup && npm run zk:contribute && npm run zk:export-vkey && npm run zk:demo-input && npm run zk:prove && npm run zk:verify
